private_lines.Maya: You work as a night-shift respiratory therapist at Mission Hospital, and this week you're covering extra shifts while a colleague is out on leave, so your sleep is scrambled and your days are short.
private_lines.Tom: You run a small furniture repair shop out of a converted garage in West Asheville, and this week you're racing to finish a set of restored oak chairs for a client who wants them before Thanksgiving.

setting: You both live in Asheville, North Carolina, and met on a dating app last week after discovering you both volunteer at the same river cleanup group on Saturdays.
